actualEvidence.reviewerReads: Only already-frozen Git TAP; no original Actions read, artifact or execution.

causalPath.fact: The fixture holds now constant until advance(ms). It sets end=now+milliseconds and breaks before invoking a timer when next.at>end.
A genuine subscription to a connected supported prepared channel invalidates using max(coverageAfter, matching-kind invalidationAfter). It enters scheduleFlush().
The exact original and candidate code both compute at=Math.max(this.localNow()+100, ...), placing the earliest refresh at now+100. The complete scheduleFlush/flush block is byte-identical to H.
All four call await f.advance(0) after subscription. The timer at now+100 is later than end=now, so no flush, refresh callback or readFresh invocation occurs before the assertion.
The two cases requiring a second read observe only the original read (1 instead of 2). The two cases expecting reuse also see 1, but can pass without exercising reuse at all.

readFixtureProtocolReview: observeSWRRead is invoked before the fetcher result; its own continuation marks received before the caller await continuation calls acceptSWRRead and writes the same response object into cache. The following microtask checks the real applied object. This ordering matches the documented SWR protocol.

The two () => true callbacks are accepts(data) for revision-free fixture data and current() for an owner still alive at the assertion. They do not bypass readFresh's read-begin/pending-dispatch comparison.

Without a dispatch proof, the observed read keeps its original read.began. Completing it after ready cannot advance that barrier. When readFresh actually runs, read.began<=after with no later pendingDispatchAt takes revalidate().
Incoming matching-kind push advances invalidationAfter even with no keys; later subscribe uses that newer boundary. A different kind leaves the bot_chat boundary unchanged.

Final prepared-channel release occurs after an actual subscriber is installed, so it does not cancel this pending flush. The immediate cause of the observed assertions is the fixture timer not being advanced.
